name: TOPIC_RESEARCH_NO_SOURCES_20261107
comment: ANCHOR: TOPIC_RESEARCH_NO_SOURCES_20261107 — DATA TRUTH P0, defect 2 (2026-11-07):
hermes:44896 was promoted, labelled provenance_grade 'wire', and asserted that 'SSDI benefits
themselves are generally excluded from MAGI calculations' while its own source list was empty
(grounded_on [], grounded_count 0). The claim is false — the taxable part of SSDI is in AGI
and therefore in MAGI — and the model wrote it from memory because the synthesizer called it
with zero articles. Two defects, one lane: the producer wrote a brief it had no source for, and
the desk graded model output as a wire dispatch and promoted it.
The gate pins: the synthesizer refuses to synthesize when no article survives the relevance
gate (the model is never called); it refuses a brief whose claims trace to none of its cited
sources; a partial trace is recorded in evidence_json.claim_trace and disclosed in data_i_doubt;
a grounding-tracked zero-source synth is graded 'ungrounded'/'no_sources' and its text withheld;
and the predicate needs an EXPLICIT zero — an absent or unreadable grounded_count is unknown,
never zero, so other research types are untouched.
